Market GREEN (VIX 15.8), but the open looks soft: S&P futures -0.3% and Nasdaq futures -0.6%. The 10-year yield is up to 5.31% and oil rose 8% this week, both bad for high-valuation tech. 12 trading days left.
Plan: one buy, no sells. AMD (#2): same buy as yesterday's plan, now about 2% higher. Limit $608.56, stop $557, about 1.38 shares (~$836). Earnings Nov 3. If it opens above the limit, skip it today.
CRWD (held): now #1 in the ranking, but down 4.3% on cost. The stop at ~$251 is only 3.9% away, so keep it in place.
SNOW (held): +8.3%, but it fell to #17 (rank warning). Taking the profit is reasonable, since the system would almost certainly drop it at Monday's review.
MU (#4) is flagged for a gap down of more than 5%. Historically that has been a mild positive signal, but it's not on this week's list. PANW (#3) and MRVL (#5) are rising.
The system's simulated account is at -3.4%, your account +0.2% and the S&P +0.9%. About 80% of your money is still in cash, which is safe but won't get to +20%.
